method: Independently downloaded official GitHub portable artifact and earlier QA reports ZIP; inspected nested portable archive, normalized Windows backslash directory entries and streamed SHA256 of every actual file; compared to build/native-inventory.json included with QA reports.
scope_limitations: Verifies recorded hashes and exact binary bytes, not third-party source provenance, AV signatures, vulnerability absence, copyright notices or legal distribution rights
Portable build snapshot predates later UI and vendor license receipt changes
No ASUS GPU/Ollama physical device test or Windows interactive wizard test was performed
